annotations.title: Romanian citations of an EU act

description: WHICH ROMANIAN ACTS AND COURT DECISIONS CITE THIS EU ACT — the bridge between the two corpora. Use it to see how a regulation or directive has actually landed in Romanian law and practice: which statutes reference it, and which Romanian courts (including the ÎCCJ and the Constitutional Court) have relied on it. Pass `article` to narrow to one article of the EU act. For a directive, pair this with eu_transposition — transposition is not the same as citation.
name: eu_cited_in_romania
